claims: s(44) = 7: README.md and the issue state s(44) >= 7 from the closed mixed cover certificate/s44_cover_7.txt (SHA-256 c9fde0f1e7013f3f61f4a8d673b6bcaf9c5e54c914b6462164d7326ba254cae0), 15,525 weighted points and 3,912 uniformly weighted pieces of the grid lines x, y in {1, ..., 6} of [0,7]^2 in Evan Daniel's mixed format v1, coordinates X/1000, weights w/10^8, total 2199755099/50000000 = 43.99510198 < 44, D4-invariant, such that every closed unit square in [0,7]^2 captures mass at least one; with the 7 x 7 grid, s(44) = 7.

The covering statement is certified by Evan Daniel's zmx2 at evand/square-packing@659ee62, unmodified: zmx2 cert --d4, VERIFIED-D4 with every root certified and no box uncertified, 191 s on one thread (verification/logs/zmx2_d4.log), and zmx2 cert --full with no symmetry reduction, VERIFIED with no box uncertified, 27.6 min on one thread (verification/logs/zmx2_full.log, zmx2_full_summary.out).

zm_mixed.py, Daniel's separately written exact-rational checker at the same commit, unmodified, run as zm_mixed.py cert FILE --d4 --depth 24 --disj --chain-from 0 over all 9,800 D4 root boxes, left 1,265 boxes uncertified in 27 roots at depth 24, and each of those 27 roots re-swept in full at --depth 30 left none, deepest leaf 29; about 143 CPU-hours, with per-root records and manifests in verification/logs/zm_mixed/ and an audit of them in verification/zm_mixed_check.py (v1.1).

verification/sanity.py (the authors', exact fractions) checks the format, the total below 44 and the D4 invariance of the point and segment measures; verification/stress.py (floating point) finds a least mass of 1.0031 over 675,000 random, near-tile and near-45-degree poses; search/tilesep.py, the authors' separation step for low-mass valleys of nearly axis-parallel squares on a wall at tilts of 0.01 to 3 degrees, finds none below 1 on the certificate.

Not done, by the source: no Lean formalization and no independent review. The paper paper/s44.pdf (also at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23769766, which the comment names) gives the reduction from the cover to the claim.
